name: TIME dotCom Berhad
summary: TIME dotCom Berhad, an investment holding company, provides telecommunications services in Malaysia and internationally. The company offers voice, data, video, and image communication, as well as other consumer home services; co-location and other related services; management services; information technology services; and value added network and system integration services.
